instruction.name: xvinsve0.w
instruction.description: Insert the first 32-bit element of `b` into lane `imm` of `a`; the other lanes are unchanged.

experiments.name: dependency chain
experiments.notes: xd -> xd chain: the preserved lanes make xd a real source.

latencies.notes: xd -> xd chain: the preserved lanes make xd a real source.

experiments.name: dependency chain
experiments.notes: xj -> xd chain: two alternating copies traverse both register paths, so the measured cycles are halved.

latencies.notes: xj -> xd chain: two alternating copies traverse both register paths, so the measured cycles are halved.

throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 1.99 cycles. Counter 0xfa normalised per instruction. The measured CPI 0.2487 is the nominal 0.25 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: xd is read because the other lanes are preserved, and the inserted element also feeds the result; both paths are 1 cycle.
